summary: Recommend standards from code2llm structure and bounded SubLLM advice

delivery.outcome: Evidence-bound project-specific standard recommendations from code2llm JSON and optional SubLLM; additive registration and protected publication.
nonGoals: No fleet-wide implicit writes or package installation
No LLM-granted authority or automatic new standard creation
No overwrite of immutable adoption pins or protected policy

architecture.decision: Extend existing adoption API with bounded AST input, catalog rules and optional SubLLM advisory proposals; expose recommend CLI and reuse additive registration. Existing fleet plan/apply handles rollout.
interfaceChanges: wellman recommend CLI and recommendation API
dataChanges: Versioned recommendation report with input digest and advisory proposals
architecture.rollback: Governed revert of recommendation API and CLI.

validation.evidence: Library/service distinction, malformed input, paths, bounded LLM advisory and no implicit effects.
Full tests, live code2llm reports and protected publication.
